index.tagline_en: A Community hub with clans, chats & DMs, drawing aids, templates, avatars everywhere, Discord & Telegram bots — does NOT modify the site's code. Uses only the site's own built-in public API. Made by the Russian-speaking Filian community.
index.new_banner: v6 — the Community update: one hub for your clan, chats, DMs and the clan browser.
index.fair_play_body: This extension does NOT modify the site's source code. Every pixel is placed by your explicit click through the site's own public API — the same endpoint the site UI calls. We read the public tile layer and your existing session cookie (the one the site already set). No patching, no hooking, no WebSocket injection, no captcha bypass. The site's JavaScript runs exactly as the developers shipped it.

community.title: Community
community.wiki_sub: The community wiki of the wall

community.title: Community super-tab
community.body: Everything social in one hub: your clan, chats (modmail · global · clan · direct messages), a clan browser with invites & applications, and the community info card. Replaces the old separate Social and Clan tabs.

overlay.title: Cozy overlay
overlay.body: Drop a PNG, snap it to coords, scale 5%–1000%, read progress %.

templates.title: Templates & sharing
templates.body: Publish templates to the public gallery or your clan, share them by link, track progress — with server-rendered PNG previews.

clan.title: Clans 2.0
clan.body: Owner-verified creation (Discord guild / site / manual), roster with roles — owner, admin, mod, member — invites, applications, settings, clan avatar + banner.

grief.title: Anti-grief alerts
grief.body: Pin a template, the backend watches it on a 4-min loop and pings the clan when damage exceeds threshold.

snapshots.title: Server snapshots
snapshots.body: Every 4 minutes the server stitches the wall at three qualities and ships them to Discord + Telegram with a signed link.

avatars.title: Avatars everywhere
avatars.body: Custom upload → Discord avatar → generated identicon. Never a broken image — in chats, rosters, templates and leaderboards.

bots.title: Discord + Telegram bots
bots.body: One unified command framework — the bots sync the wall and your clan both ways.

achievements.title: Achievements
achievements.body: 20+ unlockable badges with hidden secrets — now living in your Profile tab together with Mail.

themes.title: Themes + scaling
themes.body: Dark/light/cozy CRT mode, UI scale 80–160%, four UI languages.

accounts.title: Linked accounts
accounts.body: VAI Account SSO, Discord & Telegram OAuth, free-form + OAuth-verified social links on your profile.

install.title: Install
install.tampermonkey_step1: Install Tampermonkey from your browser's store.
install.tampermonkey_step2: Click the userscript link. Tampermonkey opens an install prompt → Install.
install.tampermonkey_step3: Open filianislost.com — the panel pops up top-right.
install.chrome_step3: Click Load unpacked → pick the unzipped folder.
install.firefox_step3: Click Load Temporary Add-on → pick manifest.json.
install.firefox_note: The Firefox build is unsigned — it stays loaded until you restart Firefox. AMO publication is planned.
install.safari_step1: Download extension-safari.zip on macOS and unzip it.
install.safari_step2: Open Terminal and run: xcrun safari-web-extension-converter ./extension-safari
install.safari_step3: Xcode opens with a generated wrapper project — build & run it once to install the extension.
install.safari_step4: In Safari → Settings → Extensions, enable “The Wall Dev”, then open filianislost.com.
install.safari_note: Safari requires a macOS + Xcode wrap and an Apple Developer ID ($99/yr) for App Store distribution. Local development install is free; we ship the raw extension payload, you do the wrap. Works on Safari 16.4+.
